title: The Department Bonus in the Circle Points Rate
content:
## The department bonus in the rate

The department of the item worked on under the agreement the profile holds with
Northbeam TechWorks Installation and Repair decides the department bonus added into the rate at which reward
points on a Northbeam Circle Membership are earned.

1. Where the department of the item that agreement was carried out on is computing, mobile or home theatre —
   a laptop or tablet, a mobile handset, a television or projector, or audio and home theatre equipment — the
   department bonus is the computing, mobile and home-theatre bonus of the tier.
2. Where the department of that item is a major appliance, the department bonus is the major appliance bonus
   of the tier.
3. Where neither of those holds, there is no department bonus, and 0 points per USD go into the rate on this
   account.

## The two tier figures the readings turn on

| Tier | Computing, mobile and home-theatre bonus (points per USD) | Major appliance bonus (points per USD) |
|---|---|---|
| Circle Free Membership | 0 | 0 |
| Circle Plus Annual | 0.5 | 0.25 |
| Circle Total Annual | 1 | 0.75 |
| Circle Total Household Annual | 1 | 1 |
| Circle Business Pro | 1.5 | 1 |
| Circle Business Elite | 2 | 1.5 |

## Cases

An agreement carried out on a mobile handset held by a member on Circle Plus Annual adds 0.5 points per USD
to the rate; the same agreement held by a member on Circle Total Household Annual adds 1, and on Circle
Business Elite 2.

An agreement carried out on a major appliance adds 0.25 on Circle Plus Annual, 1 on Circle Total Household
Annual and 1.5 on Circle Business Elite.

An agreement carried out on an item in any other department, and a profile with no such agreement, add
nothing on this account, and the department bonus then stands at 0 points per USD.
